instruction: For each clinical scenario, select the phrase for each blank so the completed sentence matches the IBRANCE prescribing information exactly.

items.prompt: Grade 3 (or recurrent Grade 3) neutropenia found on Day 1 of a cycle

blanks.before: Withhold IBRANCE until recovery to Grade

options.d: a delayed cycle start only, with no dose change

items.rationale: The FDA-approved dose-modification table for hematologic toxicity directs withholding IBRANCE for Grade 3 (or recurrent Grade 3) neutropenia on Day 1 of a cycle until the ANC recovers to Grade ≤2, then resuming at the next lower dose level rather than the same dose.
